strings.Langue de webadmin (immédiat) et du text: Language of webadmin (immediate) and of the text shown on screen by the program (after it restarts: "Save and apply"). To add a language, drop a file in the lang folder (see the documentation).
strings.Petits panneaux affichés à côté de chaqu: Small panels shown next to each aircraft on the map. Reorder the items with the arrows, choose which to show, their size, bold and italic, and whether they share the previous item's line. If everything is hidden, no panel is shown. Applied after the program restarts.
strings.Modifier ces valeurs oblige à reconstrui: Changing these values requires rebuilding the map (Map rebuild section, at the bottom of this page).
strings.Le port et l'adresse d'écoute demandent: The port and listening address require a webadmin restart. The username and password apply immediately.
strings.Réglages avancés. Une valeur vide utilis: Advanced settings. An empty value uses the default behavior.
strings.La mise à jour elle-même se lance depuis: The update itself is started from the "Updates" tab.
strings.Les changements sont appliqués immédiate: Changes apply immediately: webadmin reconnects to the MQTT server.
Display order, from top to bottom.
strings.Nécessaire pour construire la carte (lue: Required to build the map (read by build_map_vector.py).
strings.Taille de l'image de fond. Demande de re: Size of the background image. Requires rebuilding the map.
Too low: risk of a 429 error.
strings.Délai entre deux requêtes de détails d'a: Delay between two aircraft detail requests.
Beyond this, the aircraft is removed from the map.
A low value spares the Pi Zero.
strings.0 = pas de limite. Les avions plus hauts: 0 = no limit. Higher aircraft are ignored.
strings.Décochez un angle pour que le panneau n': Untick a corner so the panel is never shown there, even if an aircraft passes behind the other corners. If all are unticked, there is no restriction.
strings.La liste des avions au sol occupe déjà c: The list of aircraft on the ground already occupies this corner when it is shown.
strings.Ex. BOD. Sert à afficher « de ... » et «: E.g. BOD. Used to display "from ..." and "to ...".
strings.Un avion qui disparaît sous cette altitu: An aircraft that disappears below this altitude is considered landed.
strings.Interrupteur général. La coupure tempora: Master switch. Temporary muting is done in Control.
strings.Valeur de départ. Le curseur de Pilotage: Starting value. The slider in Control overrides it live.
strings.Les avions plus bas ne déclenchent pas l: Lower aircraft do not trigger the alert.
strings.Joue le carillon une fois au démarrage,: Plays the chime once at startup, independently of the other options in this section.
strings.Teinte rouge et carillon pendant quelque: Red tint and chime for a few seconds, even if "Sound when the program starts" is unticked.
strings.Vide : aucune protection. Le mot de pass: Empty: no protection. The password travels in clear text on the local network.
strings.Interpréteur du venv, utilisé pour build: Interpreter of the venv, used for build_map_vector.py.
strings.Arrêter l'affichage pendant la construct: Stop the display during the build
Default value of the Map tab.
strings.Interroge GitHub toutes les 12 heures po: Checks GitHub every 12 hours to report a new version. Nothing is installed without your approval.
strings.Publie l'état et accepte les commandes d: Publishes the state and accepts commands from Home Assistant.
strings.Certificat vérifié avec les autorités du: Certificate verified with the system authorities.
strings.le caractère % n'est pas autorisé dans c: the % character is not allowed in config.ini
strings.{0} : le caractère % n'est pas autorisé: {0}: the % character is not allowed in config.ini
strings.Arrêt de l'affichage pendant la construc: Stopping the display during the build...
strings.une mise à jour du logiciel est en cours: a software update is in progress
strings.une construction est déjà en cours: a build is already in progress
strings.Mise à jour terminée : webadmin tourne m: Update complete: webadmin is now running {0}.
strings.La mise à jour a été interrompue (webadm: The update was interrupted (webadmin stopped during the operation).
strings.git n'est pas installé sur ce Raspberry: git is not installed on this Raspberry Pi (sudo apt install git).
strings.git : délai dépassé (connexion à GitHub: git: timed out (connection to GitHub too slow?).
strings.Cette installation n'est pas un dépôt Gi: This installation is not a Git repository (files copied manually?). Run the installer again to be able to use updates.
strings.Le dépôt Git n'a pas de remote « origin: The Git repository has no "origin" remote: cannot reach GitHub.
An operation is already in progress.
strings.Une reconstruction de la carte est en co: A map rebuild is in progress: wait for it to finish.
Going back to the previous version ({0})...
strings.Espace disque insuffisant ({0} Mo libres: Not enough disk space ({0} MB free, {1} MB needed).
strings.Des fichiers du logiciel ont été modifié: Software files have been modified locally ({0}): update refused so nothing is overwritten.
strings.Le téléchargement depuis GitHub a échoué: The download from GitHub failed (see the log below).
strings.Aucune mise à jour : vous avez déjà la d: No update: you already have the latest version ({0}).
strings.Cette installation contient des commits: This installation contains local commits missing from GitHub: update impossible without a conflict.
strings.requirements.txt a changé : installation: requirements.txt changed: installing the libraries (can take a while on a Pi Zero)...
strings.Le code du programme d'affichage de la n: The display program code of the new version contains an error.
strings.Le code de webadmin de la nouvelle versi: The webadmin code of the new version does not load.
strings.Le programme d'affichage ne reste pas ac: The display program does not stay active with the new version.
strings.Version précédente restaurée et affichag: Previous version restored and display restarted.
strings.La nouvelle version ne démarre pas : la: The new version does not start: the previous version has been restored.
strings.affichage arrêté ou en veille : il utili: display stopped or asleep: it will use the new version at its next start
strings.Redémarrage de webadmin pour charger la: Restarting webadmin to load the new version...
strings.Le redémarrage automatique de webadmin a: The automatic restart of webadmin failed ({0}): restart it manually.
strings.Mise à jour appliquée, mais webadmin doi: Update applied, but webadmin must be restarted manually (sudo systemctl restart flightadmin).
strings.Après une extinction, il faut débrancher: After a shutdown, the power supply must be unplugged and plugged back in.
strings.La position ou le rayon de la carte a ch: The position or radius of the map has changed: the map must be rebuilt.
strings.Lance build_map_vector.py avec la positi: Runs build_map_vector.py with the position and radius from config.ini. The display is restarted at the end to load the new map.
Frees the memory of the Pi Zero.
strings.Mettre l'écran en veille ? L'affichage s: Put the screen to sleep? The display will be stopped.
strings.Éteindre le Raspberry Pi ? Il faudra le: Shut down the Raspberry Pi? It will have to be unplugged and plugged back in to turn it on again.
strings.Coupé : icône de haut-parleur barré à l': Muted: crossed-out speaker icon on screen
strings.Carillon à chaque avion entrant dans la: Chime for each aircraft entering the zone
strings.Aucun mot de passe n'est défini : toute: No password is set: anyone on the local network can control the Raspberry Pi. Set one below.
strings.Revenir à la version précédente de {0}: Go back to the previous version of {0}
strings.Remplacer le fichier par sa version préc: Replace the file with its previous version?
strings.Redémarrer webadmin ? La page sera indis: Restart webadmin? The page will be unavailable for a few seconds.
strings.Associe un code de type d'avion (ICAO) à: Associates an aircraft type code (ICAO) with an icon shape. One rule per line: the code, then the category. Lines starting with # are comments. Applied after the program restarts.
strings.Types inconnus détectés dans les logs: Unknown types detected in the logs
strings.Afficher sur la même ligne que l'élément: Show on the same line as the previous item
strings.Des fichiers du logiciel ont été modifié: Software files have been modified locally ({0}): the update is blocked so nothing is overwritten.
strings.Cette installation contient {0} commit(s: This installation contains {0} local commit(s) missing from GitHub: update impossible without a conflict.
This installation contains {0} local commit(s) missing from GitHub.
strings.Le programme d'installation (install.sh): The installer (install.sh) changed in this version. Webadmin does not update system components: if a new feature does not work, run the installer again.
strings.Télécharge la dernière version depuis Gi: Downloads the latest version from GitHub (arcalulu/flightdisplay repository). Your settings (config.ini) are kept.
strings.Webadmin redémarre, la page va se rechar: Webadmin is restarting, the page will reload...
